verdict.rationale: Penpot documents an open plugin API/system for building and publishing custom extensions (penpot-docs-5) and explicitly claims a marketplace with '113+' plugins spanning accessibility, code, AI, and design-system tools (penpot-docs-24), plus 'use community plugins or build your own' (penpot-docs-37). However this breadth claim comes from a single first-party llms.txt summary with no independent count, curated marketplace listing, or hands-on user testimony confirming diversity/quality of specific plugin types (icons, data fillers, a11y checkers); older community commentary (penpot-comm-4) even notes the plugin system was still pending as of 2022, so historical maturity is unclear. Missing for 10: independent verification of marketplace size/quality, concrete named plugin examples, and hands-on user reports using specific plugins.
